using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendCheckpointAsync_LogsInformationAtCheckpointSearchCompleted()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var mockCurrentConfig = new Mock<ICurrentConfig>();
            var mockReplicationManager = new Mock<IReplicationManager>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            var mockServerOptions = new Mock<IServerOptions>();

            // Setup clusterProvider and dependencies
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.replicationManager).Returns(mockReplicationManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(mockServerOptions.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.ClusterUsername).Returns("user");
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(p => p.ClusterPassword).Returns("pass");

            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(m => m.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockCurrentConfig.Object);

            // Setup CurrentConfig.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId to return a valid address and port
            mockCurrentConfig.Setup(c => c.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns(("127.0.0.1", 12345));

            // Setup replicationManager methods used in SendCheckpointAsync
            mockReplicationManager.SetupGet(r => r.GetRSSNetworkBufferSettings).Returns(() => null);
            mockReplicationManager.SetupGet(r => r.GetNetworkPool).Returns(() => null);

            // Setup serverOptions.TlsOptions.TlsClientOptions to null
            mockServerOptions.SetupGet(s => s.TlsOptions).Returns(() => null);
            mockServerOptions.SetupGet(s => s.ReplicaSyncTimeout).Returns(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));

            // Setup StoreWrapper.serverOptions
            mockStoreWrapper.SetupGet(s => s.serverOptions).Returns(mockServerOptions.Object);

            // Setup replicaCheckpointEntry with metadata
            var replicaCheckpointEntry = new CheckpointEntry
            {
                metadata = new Metadata
                {
                    storeVersion = 1,
                    objectStoreVersion = 1,
                    storePrimaryReplId = "primaryReplId",
                    objectStorePrimaryReplId = "objectPrimaryReplId",
                    storeHlogToken = 1,
                    storeIndexToken = 1,
                    objectStoreHlogToken = 1,
                    objectStoreIndexToken = 1
                }
            };

            // Create a partial mock of ReplicaSyncSession to override AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync
            var session = new TestReplicaSyncSession(
                mockStoreWrapper.Object,
                mockClusterProvider.Object,
                replicaCheckpointEntry,
                CancellationToken.None,
                "replicaNodeId",
                null,
                replicaCheckpointEntry,
                0,
                0,
                mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            await session.SendCheckpointAsync();

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Checkpoint search completed")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        // Helper class to override AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync for testing
        private class TestReplicaSyncSession : ReplicaSyncSession
        {
            public TestReplicaSyncSession(
                StoreWrapper storeWrapper,
                ClusterProvider clusterProvider,
                SyncMetadata replicaSyncMetadata,
                CancellationToken token,
                string replicaNodeId,
                string replicaAssignedPrimaryId,
                CheckpointEntry replicaCheckpointEntry,
                long replicaAofBeginAddress,
                long replicaAofTailAddress,
                ILogger logger)
                : base(storeWrapper, clusterProvider, replicaSyncMetadata, token, replicaNodeId, replicaAssignedPrimaryId, replicaCheckpointEntry, replicaAofBeginAddress, replicaAofTailAddress, logger)
            {
            }

            protected override Task<(CheckpointEntry, AofSyncTaskInfo)> AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync()
            {
                // Return dummy checkpoint entry and null AofSyncTaskInfo
                return Task.FromResult((new CheckpointEntry
                {
                    metadata = new Metadata
                    {
                        storeVersion = 1,
                        objectStoreVersion = 1,
                        storePrimaryReplId = "primaryReplId",
                        objectStorePrimaryReplId = "objectPrimaryReplId",
                        storeHlogToken = 1,
                        storeIndexToken = 1,
                        objectStoreHlogToken = 1,
                        objectStoreIndexToken = 1
                    }
                }, null));
            }
        }

        // Dummy classes to satisfy dependencies
        private class CheckpointEntry
        {
            public Metadata metadata { get; set; }
        }

        private class Metadata
        {
            public int storeVersion { get; set; }
            public int objectStoreVersion { get; set; }
            public string storePrimaryReplId { get; set; }
            public string objectStorePrimaryReplId { get; set; }
            public long storeHlogToken { get; set; }
            public long storeIndexToken { get; set; }
            public long objectStoreHlogToken { get; set; }
            public long objectStoreIndexToken { get; set; }
        }

        private class AofSyncTaskInfo { }

        private interface IClusterManager
        {
            ICurrentConfig CurrentConfig { get; }
        }

        private interface ICurrentConfig
        {
            (string, int) GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(string nodeId);
        }

        private interface IReplicationManager
        {
            object GetRSSNetworkBufferSettings { get; }
            object GetNetworkPool { get; }
            bool TryAcquireSettledMetadataForMainStore(CheckpointEntry entry, out LogFileInfo hlogSize, out long indexSize);
            bool TryAcquireSettledMetadataForObjectStore(CheckpointEntry entry, out LogFileInfo hlogSize, out long indexSize);
        }

        private interface IServerOptions
        {
            ITlsOptions TlsOptions { get; }
            TimeSpan ReplicaSyncTimeout { get; }
            bool DisableObjects { get; }
            bool EnableStorageTier { get; }
        }

        private interface ITlsOptions
        {
            object TlsClientOptions { get; }
        }

        private class LogFileInfo
        {
            public long hybridLogFileStartAddress;
            public long hybridLogFileEndAddress;
        }

        private class StoreWrapper
        {
            public IServerOptions serverOptions { get; set; }
        }

        private class ClusterProvider
        {
            public IClusterManager clusterManager { get; set; }
            public IReplicationManager replicationManager { get; set; }
            public IServerOptions serverOptions { get; set; }
            public string ClusterUsername { get; set; }
            public string ClusterPassword { get; set; }
            public object GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(StoreType storeType) => null;
        }

        private enum StoreType
        {
            Main,
            Object
        }
    }
}
